meta.title: Reject Quote removes the quote from the comparison view and the QCS

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be configured.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a quote line for the vendor to bid on.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one vendor whose quote will be rejected and resubmitted.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can submit a quote.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the first vendor submit the quote that will be rejected.
Confirm the initial vendor quote was accepted.
Open the buyer’s quote comparison view where the vendor quote and its three-dot menu are available.

args.goal: open the three-dot menu next to the vendor quote, select Reject Quote, leave the seller-allowed-to-bid-again box checked, confirm the rejection, and stop with the quote removed from the comparison view

steps.note: Perform the product-specific Reject Quote interaction and preserve the rebidding option.
Verify the rejected quote no longer appears in the buyer’s Responses comparison view.
Open the Quote Comparison Sheet after rejection.
Verify the rejected vendor quote is absent from Master QCS.
Have the same seller submit a new bid after rejection.
Confirm the seller was allowed to rebid successfully.
